name: Bhadmus Ibrahim
bio: Think of building software like building a house. A lot of developers just build the rooms and walk away. As a Solutions Engineer, I handle the whole property. I design the layout so it’s comfortable to use, write the code to construct the walls, connect the digital 'plumbing and electricity' so it runs smoothly on the internet, and install the automation features that save you time. I take your idea and hand you the keys to a finished, stress-free home.
